newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar gets ok to market product in Korea.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar gets ok to market product in Korea.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday the Korean Ministry of Health granted marketing approval for its AmBisome product as a primary therapy for systemic fungal infections.
The company said AmBisome now is approved by regulatory authorities for sale in 29 countries throughout the world.
Promotion and distribution in South Korea will be handled by Yuhan Corp.
The company said this is its first approval in an Eastern Asian country.

In the U.S,, AmBisome is under review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for use as a therapy for patients with a low white blood cell count who have developed a presumed fungal infection, also known as Fever of Unknown Origin.
